mapper.select: SELECT id, name, package_name, version, icon_path, platform, device_id, install_path, FROM_UNIXTIME(install_time) as installed_at, config FROM apps ORDER BY install_time DESC

SELECT id, name, package_name, version, icon_path, platform, device_id, install_path, FROM_UNIXTIME(install_time) as installed_at, config FROM apps WHERE platform = #{platform} ORDER BY install_time DESC
SELECT id, name, package_name, version, icon_path, platform, device_id, install_path, FROM_UNIXTIME(install_time) as installed_at, config FROM apps WHERE device_id = #{deviceId} ORDER BY name ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO apps (id, name, package_name, version, icon_path, platform, device_id, install_path, install_time, file_size, config) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{packageName}, #{version}, #{iconPath}, #{platform}, #{deviceId}, #{installPath}, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(#{installedAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}), 0, #{config})
mapper.update: UPDATE apps SET name = #{name}, package_name = #{packageName}, version = #{version}, icon_path = #{iconPath}, platform = #{platform}, device_id = #{deviceId}, install_path = #{installPath}, install_time = UNIX_TIMESTAMP(#{installedAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}), config = #{config} WHERE id = #{id}
